# Caring Tree Children's Dentistry

> > Compassionate pediatric dental care for children ages 0-18 in Grass Valley and Lincoln, California, led by Dr. Michelle Kucera and Dr. Chris Lee.

Caring Tree Children's Dentistry provides comprehensive pediatric dental services including preventive care, restorative treatments, oral surgery, sedation dentistry, and emergency care. The practice specializes in child-friendly approaches to dental anxiety and offers advanced treatments like Silver Diamine Fluoride and laser frenectomies.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Silver Diamine Fluoride (SDF)
- Sedation dentistry
- Restorative dentistry
- Oral surgery
- Emergency dentistry
- Preventive care

- Post-treatment care
- Dr. Michelle Kucera
- Dr. Chris Lee

## Pediatric Dental Services

- [Pediatric Dental Services Overview](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services): Overview of pediatric dental services for ages 0-18 including Silver Diamine Fluoride
- [General Dentistry](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/general-dentistry): General pediatric dental care promoting healthy oral habits in children
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/general-dentistry/silver-diamine-fluoride): Non-invasive Silver Diamine Fluoride treatment for cavity prevention and decay
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/restorative-dentistry): Tooth-colored fillings and crowns for broken, missing, or decayed teeth
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Urgent dental care for tooth trauma and dental emergencies in children

## Specialized Procedures & Sedation

- [Oral Surgery](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/oral-surgery): Pediatric oral surgery including extractions and pulpotomy with dental sedation
- [Frenectomies](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/frenectomies): Laser frenectomy procedure for tongue-tie and lip-tie treatment in infants
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/sedation-dentistry): Safe conscious sedation with nitrous oxide to manage dental anxiety in children
- [Hospital Dentistry](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/hospital-dentistry): General anesthesia hospital dentistry for special needs and anxious pediatric patients
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/teeth-whitening): Safe cosmetic teeth whitening for teens to boost smile confidence

## Post-Treatment Care Instructions

- [Post Treatment Info Overview](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/post-treatment-info): Post-treatment care instructions for crowns, extractions, fillings, and sealants
- [Post Treatment Info: Crowns](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/post-treatment-info/crowns): Aftercare instructions and pain management guidance following crown placement
- [Post Treatment Info: Extractions](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/post-treatment-info/extractions): Post-extraction care instructions including bleeding management and pain relief
- [Post Treatment Info: Fillings](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/post-treatment-info/fillings): Filling aftercare instructions for pediatric patients after treatment
- [Post Treatment Info: SDF](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/post-treatment-info/post-treatment-info-sdf): Post-care instructions following Silver Diamine Fluoride cavity treatment

## Technology & Innovation

- [Advanced Dental Technology](https://www.caringtreechildrensdentistry.com/services/technology): Advanced dental technology including digital X-rays and intraoral cameras
